title: Viagem de avião
goal: Revise am/is/are going to para falar de planos e perguntar sobre eles.
reading: June is going to fly to Toronto.
She is going to meet her cousin there.
Ela vai encontrar a prima lá.
Her airplane is going to leave at nine.
O avião dela vai partir às nove.
At the airport she is going to find gate nine.
No aeroporto ela vai achar o portão nove.
Her cousin is going to wait at the door.
A prima dela vai esperar na porta.
dialogue: When are you going to fly?
I am going to fly on Monday.
Yes, I am going to Toronto.
Is it going to be a small airplane?
No, it is going to be a big jet.
Não, vai ser um jato grande.
Is your cousin going to meet you?
Yes, she is going to be at the gate.
Sim, ela vai estar no portão.
pron: Em airplane o acento fica em AIR; em gate o a soa como ei.
gram: I ___ going to fly on Monday.
Com I usamos am going to.
